Sends authentication via custom header (X-API-Key)

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"auth\":{\"name\":\"X-API-Key\",\"type\":\"header\",\"value\":\"sk-test-key-12345\"},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.auth_header_sent)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
```
